text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Seiun Sky was, I 
decided to have her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I feel bad since I'm always taking time 
off whenever I want.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, since it's an official day off, I 
think I'll gratefully take a nap.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh my, oh my. Goodness me. I seem to 
have wandered into a wonderland."

text_block_list.name: Cat God
text_block_list.text:
Meow. ...Welcome, Seiun Sky. I am the Cat 
God...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! A talking kitty cat!

text_block_list.name: Cat God
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky, it seems you're quite fond of 
pampering cats on a daily basis, meow.

text_block_list.name: Cat God
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall grant you one wish, 
nya. What is it you desire, nya?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~? ...For now, can I think about it 
while fluffing up your tummy?

text_block_list.name: Cat God
text_block_list.text: Do as you like, nya.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yay~. Ooh~, as expected of a deity. What 
magnificent fur.

text_block_list.name: Cat God
text_block_list.text: Mnyah... And so the wish is...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Fluffy, fluffy.

text_block_list.name: Cat God
text_block_list.text: N-Neko... *purr*... *myaaah*...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, not just the belly. Under the 
chin too, so fluffy, so floofy~...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm~. Slept like a log. I feel like I 
had a really nice dream...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, my body feels so light. ...Guess 
this means I can't really slack off, huh?

Returning from the nurse's office, Seiun 
Sky seems to be feeling much better.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
All right, Sei-chan's secret technique: 
tummy tickle attack! How do you like that!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Then, chin scritches! And bum 
pats!

text_block_list.name: Cat God
text_block_list.text:
...Totally useless, nya! What have you 
learned from all the fluffing up until 
now, nya!?

text_block_list.name: Cat God
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting my training over from 
scratch, nya! SHAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Eeeehhh~!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like I had an awful dream that 
totally crushed my confidence...

Seiun Sky seemed to have had a bad dream, 
and didn't look well-rested at all...
